tagline: Eighty miles of freeway, with the lakes waiting off the exits.
intro: I-69 comes up out of Indiana into the farmland and woodland of Branch County, passes Coldwater Lake and curves around the east side of Coldwater. It crosses into Calhoun County and over the St. Joseph River, bypasses Tekonsha, curves around Nottawa Lake, and crosses the Kalamazoo River at Marshall on the way to the Eaton County line, 80 miles in all.
It is a four-lane freeway, and the point of it lies off the exits. Branch County has more than 100 inland lakes and sells more fishing licenses than any other county in Michigan.

moments.title: Tibbits Opera House, Coldwater
moments.text: A cigar maker named Tibbits built it in 1882, when Coldwater was a day's trip from both Detroit and Chicago and touring players stopped on the way through.

moments.title: Marshall
moments.text: So sure of being made the state capital that it built a governor's mansion, Marshall lost the vote to Lansing and became known instead for its nineteenth-century architecture.
